messages:
anya.design: Morning 44b dropped a new take on console nav: attempting a more compact grouping + explicit deep-link contract. figma: https://figma.redwood/console/nav-compact-v3
josh.pm: looks promising. quick question: will this change how bookmarked URLs behave? we have a few customers who rely on stable paths.
lee.frontend: bookmarking is the sticky part. plan: canonical routes stay stable, but we will create a set of aliases and a canonicalize middleware to normalize incoming paths. non-canonical -> redirect or show migration banner, TBD.
sam.platform: prefer 302 on first access for UX, then 301 after 30d once metrics look good. also capture query params so we don't lose UI state like `?panel=insights`.
maya.a11y: concern: when groups are re-ordered and focusable items move, keyboard users lose context. suggestion: after a layout swap, set focus to the closest logical item and run an aria-live brief: "Navigation updated, focus moved to X."
anya.design: good. UX note: breadcrumbs should represent the resource hierarchy (Org / Workspace / Area / Page) rather than verbs. add compact action chips next to crumbs for common tasks (Edit, View logs).
josh.pm: on copy: change breadcrumb separator to a subtle chevron glyph (U+203A) and ensure screenreaders read it as "breadcrumb separator" or skip it via aria-hidden.
lee.frontend: implementation detail: we'll use `aria-hidden` on the visual separator and add `aria-label` on the nav landmark. also add `data-legacy-path` attributes on items to aid the server-side redirect map.
sam.platform: telemetry: record `redirect.source`, `redirect.count`, and `experiment.variant`. keep redirect logs for 45 days. export a report before we remove aliases.
maya.a11y: small nit: avoid relying on hash fragments for critical navigation state; some assistive tech doesn't treat them as navigational events. prefer path segments + query params.
anya.design: agreed. path contract proposal: `/console/:org/:workspace/:section/:resourceId` and optional query params for UI-only state. I'll add that to the spec.
josh.pm: rollout plan idea: internal dogfood -> 15% experiment cohort -> opt-out feedback banner -> full rollout. deprecation plan: keep aliases for min 60 days with redirect telemetry.
lee.frontend: dev work: alias table + middleware + migration banner + aria-live behavior + keyboard focus tests. ETA 4 dev days incl. unit tests.
sam.platform: I'll wire feature flag and metrics dashboard. will also add an alert if redirect counts spike unexpectedly.
maya.a11y: I'll author test cases and run a screenreader walkthrough during canary. also checklist: focus order, contrast, announce collapse/expand counts.
anya.design: sweet. I'll update Figma, spec doc, and add copy for the migration banner: "You're seeing an updated navigation. Update bookmark? [Save link]".
josh.pm: small UX detail: show a subtle toast when redirect occurs: "Old link redirected to new location. Click to copy new URL."
lee.frontend: ok will add copy and copy-to-clipboard action.
ticket-bot: Created RED-4721: "Console nav: compact grouping, alias redirects, breadcrumb contract" assigned to lee.frontend, sam.platform; due 2025-12-01.
